# Bug Report Template

Use this for QA, ANA lab issues, mobile testing, AI workflow bugs, or customer
technical support cases.

## Title

Short, specific description of the issue.

## Summary

What happened in one or two sentences.

## Environment

- Date:
- OS:
- App/build/version:

- Network/setup:

What should happen.

## Actual Result

## Frequency

- Always
- Sometimes
- Once

## Severity

- Critical: blocks core workflow, data loss, security/privacy issue
- High: major feature broken, no reasonable workaround
- Medium: feature partially broken, workaround exists
- Low: cosmetic, text, minor annoyance

## Evidence

- Logs:
- Screenshot/video:
- Report path:
- Error message:
- Related file/function:

Do not attach private secrets, tokens, raw customer data, or sensitive logs
unless the destination is authorized and private.

## Impact

Who is affected and why it matters.

## Suspected Area

Optional. Only include if there is evidence.

## Workaround

Known workaround, if any.

## Recommended Next Step

Smallest useful next action.

## Privacy / Safety Notes

Mention if the report contains private data, lab-only evidence, or security
details that must not be shared publicly.
